purpose: Express a hope or gently suggest a favorable outcome.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
Plain nonpast + といい; たら-form + いい
I hope it is sunny tomorrow.
I hope I can pass the exam.
If you are tired, you could rest a little.
formation: Plain nonpast + といい; たら-form + いい
restrictions: For hopes outside one’s direct control; advice depends on context.
mistake: An unqualified hope about your own deliberate action is less natural than an intention.
